title: Understanding the Function
text: The function $$f(x)=\frac{1}{\pi} \arctan\left(x\right)+\frac{1}{2}$$ is a scaled inverse tangent function. It is important to understand how this function behaves compared to the logistic function.

title: Behavior of the Function
text: The function $$f(x)=\frac{1}{\pi} \arctan\left(x\right)+\frac{1}{2}$$ is always between $$0$$ and $$1$$, similar to the logistic function. This is because the arctan function has horizontal asymptotes at $$\frac{-\pi}{2}$$ and $$\frac{\pi}{2}$$.

title: Comparing Tail-End Behavior
text: Both the logistic function and the scaled inverse tangent function have similar tail-end behavior, meaning they approach $$0$$ and $$1$$ as $$x$$ approaches negative and positive $$\infty$$, respectively.
